text:
priya: quick callout for the GA gating decision: Dedicated capacity ship scope. we keep hearing "burst" asks but need to pick a conservative default that minimizes infra churn. thoughts? :thinking_face:
anya: runtime constraints summary: per-tenant prewarm adds metadata & reconciliation complexity. safe path is pool-level smoothing with an opt-in per-tenant preheat for early customers.
mike: infra POV: opt-in preheat reduces blast radius and lets us avoid heavy billing integration at launch. we can do pool smoothing + visible stats first.
kate: sales/legal: customers want something they can promise to execs. opt-in is fine for pilots but enterprise contracts expect clearer wording. we'll need explicit "no guaranteed burst" verbiage unless they pay for reserved headroom.
sam: cs: ACME pilot asked for an easy way to request temporary extra headroom during product launches. an opt-in manual toggle with a 30m max window would work for them.
priya: proposal A (GA-minimal): enable pool smoothing by default (3x soft multiplier), surface per-tenant metrics, preheat OFF by default; allow opt-in temporary preheat for pilot tenants via support toggle (30m window, manual approval).
priya: proposal B (GA-plus): preheat ON by default at pool-level with small per-tenant credit bucket (50k tokens/hr), auto-decay carryover 2x hourly, automatic opt-out when tail latency rises. more infra + billing work.
anya: technical differences: A = minimal code changes, quicker release. B = more bookkeeping and reconciliation; higher test surface.
mike: timelines: A -> 1 sprint to ship (smoothing, metrics, support toggle). B -> 3 sprints (accounting, billing hooks, carryover rules, circuit-breaker).
kate: contract text for A: "Burst behavior is a pool-level smoothing mechanism that mitigates short traffic spikes. It is not a guaranteed capacity increase. Customers requiring guaranteed burst should purchase reserved headroom."
legal-bot: note: flagged clause "not a guaranteed capacity increase" for compliance review.
sam: operational ask: if opt-in preheat is manual today, we need an on-call playbook for approving/rejecting requests and a small UI in console to request temporary headroom.
priya: UI can be basic in GA: request button sends ticket to CS/ops. GA+1: self-serve compressed flow.
anya: safety features we must include for A: (1) per-pool smoothing alpha parameter, (2) tail-latency monitor that disables smoothing for a pool for 10m if 95p > 2x baseline, (3) KV-warmup metric and alert when miss-rate > threshold.
mike: autoscale defaults for A: quick scale-up (1.4x/min), conservative scale-down (cooldown 12m). keep these tunables in runtime flags.
priya: decision ask: choose A or B for GA. my recommendation: A (GA-minimal) to hit timelines and avoid billing/legal blockers. reserve B items for GA+1 with a clear roadmap.
kate: +1 for A if we add clear customer communications and an explicit paid add-on path.
sam: +1 for A, but please prioritize a simple request flow for preheat for pilots.
anya: +1 technical. we'll add the disabling circuit and KV alerts.
mike: +1 from infra for A. I'll owner subtask for smoothing and metrics.
priya: action items: mike -> PROD-6001 owner for smoothing + metrics; anya -> runtime safety checks; kate -> contract blurb; sam -> request-runbook & CS template.
deploy-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-6001 "Dedicated GA: pool smoothing + opt-in preheat pilot flow" assigned to @mike
priya: gating note for roadmap: GA requires smoothing enabled + telemetry + opt-in flow for pilots. no default per-tenant preheat. B items (credit accounting, billing hooks, self-serve preheat) move to GA+1 backlog.
kate: i'll prepare customer-facing FAQ and a one-paragraph addendum for sales decks that explains the pilot path.
mike: i'll break PROD-6001 into subtasks: smoothing impl, metrics pipeline, flag for opt-in, CI tests. ETA: next sprint for base tasks.
anya: will add circuit-breaker task as part of PROD-6001 subtasks.
sam: i'll coordinate ACME pilot and prepare the request template.
priya: thanks team. follow-up doc will land in roadmap doc and i'll block GA toggle until telemetry verification. quick sync tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:
